🎯 𝗨𝗦𝗘 𝗖𝗔𝗦𝗘: To create a private, secure, and distributed network for running Dockerized GPU workloads among trusted peers, leveraging idle GPU resources without external cloud dependencies.
📅 Created: Aug 2026 • Updated: Sep 2026

◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇◇

✨ 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗙𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗘𝗦 ✨

✅ Authenticated peer-to-peer connections for Docker GPU jobs
✅ No SSH, VPN, or cloud infrastructure required
✅ Default-deny allowlist for security
✅ Jobs run within containers
✅ Mutual pairing with signed codes
✅ QUIC P2P networking with optional relay
✅ Docker + NVIDIA job execution with VRAM hints and retries
✅ Group management for teams of GPUs
✅ File copy and sandboxed command execution
✅ Local dashboard for monitoring and control
✅ Public registry for metadata (not workloads)
✅ Desktop tunneling (RDP/VNC) and CUDA remoting

GPUMesh enables secure, peer-to-peer sharing of Docker GPU jobs among trusted users without relying on centralized cloud services or complex network configurations like SSH or VPNs. It facilitates turning idle NVIDIA GPUs into a private, distributed compute network.

Caesium Web Image Compressor is a privacy-focused, offline web application that allows users to compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images directly in their browser. It supports both lossy and lossless compression, preserves image metadata, and offers a before/after comparison feature, ensuring no images are uploaded or processed on external servers.
